alignments.note: The ASV supplies a whole lexical verb and its object for a clause whose Hebrew has none; no morpheme licenses either word (rule 20). The edition's italics corroborate without deciding (rule 7).
Construct relation recast as an English possessive, so the determiner stands before the possessor's word and goes to it (rule 29).
Construct noun keeps only its own word, rendered command.

A coordinator and a subordinator written together at the clause's left edge are one rendering of the single waw, headed on the coordinator (rule 55). The competing reading takes t009 as an added supply.
Preposition → in; the ASV writes a word for each of עַל and דִּבְרַת, so rule 2 splits rather than rule 30 fusing.
Rectum takes the of; the supplied the joins the noun (rules 19, 15).
Second-level rectum takes its own of, headed on the name.

review_notes: I counsel thee is the ASV's supplied frame; only the written אֲנִי takes I, and counsel thee is added under rule 20's supplied-lexical-verb clause.
and that is read as one waw's rendering under rule 55's coordinator-plus-subordinator sentence; the alternative leaves that added.
